name: Sméagol
subtitle: Old Noser
game_text:
<keyword>Ring-bound</keyword>. To play, add a burden.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Sméagol (or Gollum) twice to reveal the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Wound a minion for each Shadow card revealed. Place those 4 cards beneath your draw deck in any order.
flavor_text: “‘Could you find anything fit for a hungry hobbit?’”
